summary:
Built a 17×13 adobe market hall as code (`build.mjs`, saved as `build.nbt`) with `mcd` brushes. The body is 8 tall; the dome and wind tower take it to 11 layers, over the 9-tall brief.
The walls are 2-thick sandstone with deep reveals, orange terracotta bands and corner buttresses. The front has two stall bays under striped awnings and an arched portal with a signboard.
The roof is `mcd roof --preset desert`, dry-run first with no warnings. I then added dome, wind tower, terrace canopy, vigas, pots and baskets, and a hall interior.
`mcd check` shows 0 floating blocks and 0 unsupported attachments. The 17 orphans it lists are the viga ends, which stick out by design.
Also written: `elements.md`, `tasks.json` (11 tasks) and `gaps.md`. Two caveats: the preset's tower was replaced by a hand-built one, and the roof needed a manual `--footprint` because auto-detect returned an empty footprint on this wall.
elements: Thick rounded adobe walls → 2-thick sandstone / smooth / cut sandstone front with carved reveals, corner buttress piers capped with slabs (rounding is only slab caps)
Orange bands → orange_terracotta at y2-3 on piers, sides and back
Vigas → dark_oak_log ends (axis z / x) sticking out 1 block at the frieze, every 2 blocks, on all four sides and on the wind tower
Flat roof with parapet → `mcd roof --preset desert` (sandstone deck, parapet and coping), retoned to sandstone, plus dark oak fence railings on the front and east edges

Shaded arcade with striped awnings → two-row slopes of alternating red_sandstone_stairs and smooth_quartz_stairs over both stalls on dark oak fence posts, plus a slab-stripe canopy on the roof terrace
Arched entrance → arch() carve through the 2-thick wall, dark oak corbel stairs, signboard 'BAZAAR', hanging lanterns, orange/white carpet runway, slab steps and landing
Clay pots → decorated_pot blocks and potted_cactus / potted_dead_bush on the platform, stalls and back door
Woven baskets and goods → composters, barrels and hay_blocks as stall tables, on the terrace and by the back door
Dome → dome() brush with an orange_terracotta drum ring, smooth sandstone hemisphere and dark oak fence finial
Wind tower → hand-built 3×3 sandstone shaft with an orange band, iron_bars slits and dark oak viga ends
Windows and life → iron_bars grilles with open dark_oak_trapdoor shutters on the sides and back, striped wall banners on the buttresses and back door, hanging lanterns inside
polish: Overall height is 11 layers (8 for the body, dome and tower above), against the 9-tall brief.
The walls are not truly rounded: only slab-capped corner buttresses; the vertical edges are square.
The dome is a squat terraced stack with only the drum ring in orange, and there is no mid-dome band. The wind tower is small and the same tone as the dome, so it merges with it.
The portal arch is hidden behind the dark lintel board and the 'BAZAAR' text is tiny. A proper arch head and a readable name board are still needed.
Awning white stripes are smooth_quartz stairs (flagged by `mcd palette` as an outlier), and there is no valance or cloth edge.

The walls are one tone (sandstone on smooth sandstone, flagged trim-invisible). The `weather` and `vary` rules added stray granite-grey blocks, so I removed them and left the walls without texture variation.
The hall interior is only lightly furnished, and the back and side walls above the band are plain.
Banner patterns and the decorated pots render only as approximated boxes in the viewer.
